fracture.basis: Strict chronology from 1932 murder through Paris training, Rome, the failed morning, the cell.

dread.basis: War closes in — forbidden combat, city about to fall, 400 children on foot — but each crisis resolves rather than hangs.

cruelty.basis: A jet strafes refugees and En Soon Yang dies shielding a girl; the film's disposition is grief and dedication, not dwelling on harm.

irony.basis: Pine-tree parable, dying-man's comfort restoring his ministry, orphanage dedicated to her — the images mean exactly what they say.

ambiguity.basis: Guilt named, faith restored, orphans delivered, epilogue visit to the finished orphanage beside the two pines.

fracture.basis: Straight forward run from summer 1950 to the post-Armistice visit; the Germany bombing is stated backstory, not a displacement.

dread.basis: The Paris escape curdles into an announced abortion plan; April's too-calm breakfast makes the morning a wait for what she'll do.

cruelty.basis: Arguments aimed to wound ('only to prove the first was not a mistake'), the self-administered aspiration, the bleeding, the death watched through.

irony.basis: The 'perfect couple' facade, the asylum patient as the only truth-teller, and a husband switching off his hearing aid to close the film.

ambiguity.basis: Death, cause, aftermath and the house's next occupants all shown; even the neighbours' verdicts are delivered aloud.

fracture.basis: 1948 meeting forward to the death, then a stated 'years later' coda; no reordering.

dread.basis: Contract-killing offer and a faked burial supply threat, but the beating and destitution arrive as reversals rather than anticipated harm.

cruelty.basis: Impotence exposed in open court, arson framed on him, forced to listen to her sex by phone — then he engineers her imprisonment.

irony.basis: The 'suicide' contract fires a blank and restores the client's will to live; his revenge is a will leaving her everything.

ambiguity.basis: Ends on her signing through a cell window that she'll remarry him and his tears — neither her sincerity nor his next move is settled.

fracture.basis: Court, exile, Warsaw fortune, faked death, prison visit — one forward chain.

dread.basis: The worst hazards are snow on a mountain road and a car stuck at a turnoff; no one is under threat at any point.

cruelty.basis: Every refusal is gentle — Maud recovers at once from his pulling away, Françoise rejects a kiss softly, and he forgives her past affair.

irony.basis: The Pascal-quoting Catholic's certainty is undone by the beach coincidence; he swallows the discovery and she smiles it away.

ambiguity.basis: He never broaches that Françoise was Maud's husband's mistress; whether she knows he knows is sealed by a swim.

fracture.basis: Consecutive days told in order, then one clean five-year jump to the beach.

dread.basis: From 'They're here' the house escalates continuously — tree, closet portal, the Beast — though the 'house is clean' scene grants a real lull.

cruelty.basis: Assaults are supernatural and the family escapes whole; the corpses in the pool are exhumed, not victims made on camera.

irony.basis: The developer moved the headstones and not the bodies; the rescued family checks into a motel and Steve wheels out the TV.

ambiguity.basis: The medium explains the spirits, the Beast and the light; Teague's grave-moving supplies the cause outright.

fracture.basis: Night by night in strict order from the first television contact to the flight from Cuesta Verde.

dread.basis: Mostly wonder and errands; menace enters only with the coerced sex and the scissors, late and briefly.

cruelty.basis: The boss coerces her into sex, her maker says used dolls go out with the garbage, and she leaves Junichi's body with the garbage.

irony.basis: The premise is played straight — the maker's belief that dolls have hearts is offered as truth, and her deflation is meant as it looks.

ambiguity.basis: Her coming to life is never accounted for and Hideo never recognises her; the ending is emotionally decisive but causally unexplained.

fracture.basis: One forward sequence from her waking through the video store, the factory, the killing, her deflation.

dread.basis: Unmanned locomotives accelerating for most of the film, brakes burned out, derailment orders and a chemical-plant curve ahead

cruelty.basis: Three years' solitary under a cruel warden, Manny forcing Buck onto the frozen nose, a man falling under the train, hand crushed

irony.basis: The arms-wide embrace of death is played straight; only the closing Richard III title stands slightly outside the image

ambiguity.basis: Every fate is shown or stated — Manny's choice, Ranken handcuffed, the other engines coasting to a stop

fracture.basis: Single forward order from solitary to the vanishing engine, no displacement anywhere

dread.basis: Harm arrives abruptly (the botched robbery, the self-stabbing) rather than being awaited; the afterlife stretch is procedural, not menacing

cruelty.basis: He beats Julie and slaps his daughter, but the film's machinery exists to absolve him — the slap is converted into a kiss

irony.basis: Heaven run as a police station: God's Police, an officious commissioner, an angel-typist, a silent film of his own beating

ambiguity.basis: The scales tip, the name is erased from the devil's tablet — the verdict is delivered explicitly

fracture.basis: Straight forward order; the sixteen-year jump is an ellipsis, not a displacement

dread.basis: Caged by Stromboli, boys braying into donkeys and sold off, swallowed by Monstro — long stretches of anticipated harm between safe ones

cruelty.basis: The Coachman's trade in children as slave labor and Lampwick's transformation watched by Pinocchio as it happens

irony.basis: A wish on a star is granted literally and the moral is handed out as a gold badge

ambiguity.basis: Death reversed, boy made real, conditions stated at the start and confirmed at the end

fracture.basis: One continuous forward line from the workshop to the celebration

dread.basis: Opens on the corpse, so the whole retrospect is spent waiting for it; stroke, failed surgery, second stroke, one-way decline

cruelty.basis: The second nurse's mistreatment and the pillow held down, but the caretaking is dutiful and the promise honored

irony.basis: The childhood story, the washed flowers, the released pigeon — offered without any protective distance

ambiguity.basis: Georges follows the imagined Anne out the door and is simply gone; the film never says what became of him

fracture.basis: One displacement: the discovery of the body first, months rewound, then the opening scene resumed at the close

dread.basis: An affair prosecutable as Rassenschande, repeated warnings that the POW is in lethal danger, and the town watching

cruelty.basis: Stanisław tried and executed for the affair; the official who warned her then abandoned her and still lives in the village

irony.basis: The frame's mistrustful villagers set the town's account against what 1941 shows, but the telling itself stays plain

ambiguity.basis: The 1941 events are laid out, but the present-day frame ends only in the descendants' appalled recognition

fracture.basis: Two time frames — a present-day inquiry bracketing the 1941 story, which is reached only through it

dread.basis: Ambushes, capture and torture arrive as adventure reverses; the momentum is revenge and treasure, not anticipated harm

cruelty.basis: A guardian ordered to kill an infant, Jolanda captured and tortured, Van Guld left adrift in a boat of lepers

irony.basis: Disguise and mistaken love are plot mechanics, not commentary; the vengeance and treasure are meant as stated

ambiguity.basis: Origins revealed by the dying guardian, villain disposed of, treasure taken — nothing withheld

fracture.basis: Forward order throughout, with the backstory delivered as spoken exposition rather than displaced telling

dread.basis: A coffin of stolen banknotes that must survive a posse search, a memorial service, and a man who knew the dead captain's wife

cruelty.basis: A blind sergeant murdered for photographs, a girl raped and killed with a bayonet, Claire whipped and left in a storm to sicken

irony.basis: A whole film of counterfeit mourning — fake widow, fake funeral — closed by the wrong coffin holding the bandit chief

ambiguity.basis: The switched coffin is explained, brothers shoot each other over the money, Jonas dies on screen

fracture.basis: Continuous journey chronology from the massacre to the riverbank

dread.basis: Mostly investigative — traced calls, dead ends, hearings; threat spikes only at the tank fight and the sniper attempt

cruelty.basis: A diplomat assassinated, ghost-hacked people used as disposable tools, Kusanagi's shell torn apart, a cover-up by sniper

irony.basis: The Puppet Master's argument about what constitutes a human is presented as the film's own question, unhedged

ambiguity.basis: The merged entity is declared to be neither of them, and the film ends on her not knowing where to go

fracture.basis: Case advances in one forward order from the interpreter's hack to the safe house

dread.basis: A wanted cop-killer, yet the time is spent chasing money and sex; the police close in only at the very end

cruelty.basis: An impulsive roadside shooting and a phoned-in betrayal, neither dwelt on; the dying is brief and then done

irony.basis: He models himself on American movie gangsters, and she ends by looking into the camera and copying his lip gesture

ambiguity.basis: She turns him in unsure whether to protect or destroy him, and his last words stay uncomprehended

fracture.basis: Marseille to Paris to the street, one forward run with no displacement

dread.basis: An untraceable marksman still at large after 29 killings, striking again at a mall and rigging grenades for the SWAT team

cruelty.basis: Mass shootings, a corpse in a meat grinder, a mother taking her own life at the shed, Dean asking to be executed asleep

irony.basis: The closing bargain — silence traded for a job and a manufactured heroic tribute to the man their failures killed

ambiguity.basis: Shooter identified, motive traced to the slaughterhouse, death and cover-up both shown; only her empathy is left unweighed

fracture.basis: Investigation runs strictly forward from New Year's Eve to the FBI office

dread.basis: Assassins, trapdoor, a wounding — but threat arrives in bursts and each escape is engineered; motion is caper appetite, not fear.

cruelty.basis: Forced marriage, a drugged bride and two betrayals at knife-point, yet no harm is dwelt on and the ending is farewell and joy.

irony.basis: Disguises and a closing joke charge of 'stealing Clarisse's heart' — playful, but the rescue and the ruins are meant straight.

ambiguity.basis: The counterfeiting, the treasure and Clarisse's rule are all explained on screen; the treasure is literally drained into view.

fracture.basis: Straight forward order; one backfilled fact (she saved him ten years earlier) told, not shown out of sequence.

dread.basis: Theft-and-pursuit anxiety hands off to a watching eye at the peephole, then two more people walk toward the same house.

cruelty.basis: 'Brutally stabs her to death', a second stabbing on the stairs, a mummified corpse in the cellar, poisoning of the mother.

irony.basis: The 'private trap' speech and the psychiatrist's summary are both delivered in earnest; no distance from its own images.

ambiguity.basis: Dr Richmond explains motive, method and prior victims; the last shot hauls the car up and completes the accounting.

fracture.basis: One forward line, its protagonist replaced mid-film; only the backstory of Norma's death is reported retrospectively.

dread.basis: Death has already happened; the week's only pressure is a deadline to remember something happy.

cruelty.basis: Counsellors coax rather than press — the girl steered off Splash Mountain, the refuser simply left alone.

irony.basis: Cotton-wool clouds and jostled trolley sets expose the artifice, yet the film credits the recreated memory completely.

ambiguity.basis: Who runs the way station, what lies past the screening, and what becomes of the wild-haired refuser are never settled.

fracture.basis: One forward week; life material enters as interviews and videotape playback rather than displaced scenes.

dread.basis: From Travis's unanswered pleas onward the fall is stated as inevitable; El Degüello announces no quarter days in advance.

cruelty.basis: No-quarter order, Crockett executed for a taunt, and 700 sleeping soldiers massacred by 'vengeful Texans' at San Jacinto.

irony.basis: Ends with Crockett's ghost fiddling at peace over the mission — offered without any hedge.

ambiguity.basis: Siege, fall, retreat, San Jacinto and Santa Anna's surrender terms all close in order; nothing withheld.

fracture.basis: Dated chronological march from the 1835 party to San Jacinto; only the spectral coda sits outside it.

dread.basis: Blight and starvation frame it and the tsunami, Mann and the spinning dock are lethal, but stretches run on wonder and problem-solving.

cruelty.basis: Two deliberate betrayals — Brand's lifelong lie, Mann's falsified data and attempt to kill — but deaths are quick and not lingered over.

irony.basis: Whispered promises, a bookshelf ghost that turns out to be love across dimensions, played entirely straight.

ambiguity.basis: The bootstrap is spelled out (Cooper is the ghost), Murph's equations succeed, Amelia is shown breathing the air.

fracture.basis: Earth years and ship hours are cut against each other, and the tesseract re-enters the film's own opening scenes from inside.

dread.basis: Three women bleeding or overdue in one ward; every scene waits on an outcome, and two of the three go badly.

cruelty.basis: Contractions 'increasingly violent and excruciating' held until the stillbirth, then the doctor's 'it wasn't meant to be'.

irony.basis: Confessions at bedsides taken at face value — Cecilia's realisation, Hjördis's phone call — with no distance from them.

ambiguity.basis: Hjördis is told to come home and it ends there; nothing settles what any of the three lives becomes.

fracture.basis: Consecutive hospital stay, the three cases interleaved but never displaced in time.

dread.basis: Opens with him restrained in a padded cell, so every step toward Hobb's End is already known to end badly; it never lets up.

cruelty.basis: Cane deliberately exposes Linda to the manuscript to drive her mad, a man kills himself on cue, John axes a fan.

irony.basis: He watches the film of his own story replay him saying 'this is reality' and laughs — the irony turns on the medium itself.

ambiguity.basis: Cane says John exists only because he wrote him, and nothing after ever establishes whether the telling has an author or a world.

fracture.basis: Asylum frame containing the whole account, plus loops that teleport him back to the town centre and a final replay of the events.

dread.basis: The worst prospects are a move to New York and a missed World's Fair; even the Halloween injury resolves into a misunderstanding.

cruelty.basis: Esther attacks John over a false accusation and the sisters sabotage Lucille's dance card — both undone within the scene.

irony.basis: The Christmas song, the snowmen, the lights on the Grand Lagoon are all offered without a wink.

ambiguity.basis: Father reverses the move, Warren proposes, Rose and Esther are settled, and the Fair arrives as promised.

fracture.basis: Seasonal blocks summer to the following spring in strict order; the gaps between them never reorder anything.
